title: MMGN Boilerplate - CLI & Starter Kit
description: A production-ready base template and custom CLI tool published on npm (bunx mmgn@latest) that automates project scaffolding, allowing users to choose via commands between a Full Dashboard setup (auth + i18n + CRUD) or a standalone Landing Page.
architecture: Feature-first structure featuring a comprehensive authentication flow, bilingual translation (ES/EN), dynamic theme management, and an example CRUD connected to Supabase with Row Level Security.
technical_details: Resolved three non-trivial integration bugs: collision between Supabase middleware and next-intl (merging responses), dynamic locale imports failing in Next.js (migrated to static imports with TypeScript records), and conditionally executed useId hook. Configured Prisma 7 with a decoupled adapter-pg database connector outside the main schema file; used CSS-first Tailwind v4 for seamless dark mode compatibility.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: A bilingual personal portfolio combining a Next.js frontend with an independent backend built in Python (FastAPI) and Supabase.
architecture: Responsive frontend interface incorporating neobrutalist design principles and feature-based folder organization. Decoupled backend in FastAPI with Pydantic schema validation and database persistence in Supabase.
technical_details: Backend stack intentionally differs from the frontend to demonstrate versatility with Python. Integrated Resend API for automated email notifications and implemented localization support via i18next.

title: ClassAid - Fullstack Platform for Teacher Management
description: An application designed to help educators manage their classrooms, assisting in data organization, grading, and tracking student progress throughout the course.
architecture: Fullstack platform featuring a secure login flow for teachers via JWT tokens.
technical_details: Organized the server code by class modules to facilitate maintenance and scalability. Connected to a MongoDB database with endpoints thoroughly validated via Postman. Built under a modular architecture that successfully reduced iteration times by 20%.

title: Web Around - Interactive Application
description: Interactive application where users can modify page content and see updates reflected immediately on the screen.
architecture: Dynamic interface based on React components with real-time state management. REST backend with Express and MongoDB for data persistence per authenticated user.
technical_details: Vite as bundler for development environment optimization. Reusable components to reduce code duplication. Frontend form validation before server submission.
